stem: A child is found to have a button battery lodged in the nose; what is the most appropriate next step?
explanation: Urgent removal is required because a button battery in the nose can rapidly cause local tissue injury, including septal damage.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes

optionExplanations.A: Correct because a nasal button battery is an emergency and should be removed urgently to prevent tissue necrosis and septal perforation.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because routine review delays treatment and allows ongoing tissue injury.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because home observation is unsafe for a button battery in the nose.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because saline does not address the battery and is not definitive management.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because spontaneous passage should not be awaited when a button battery is lodged in the nose.
